model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в абсолютната средна стойност на скритото състояние (Hidden State Mean) в зависимост от слоя на модела. Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Abs Mean" и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 4.5, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 0.5 единици (0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5).

На графиката са представени три линии. Първата линия, в син цвят с пунктиран стил, представлява „hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Тя започва при стойност около 0.1 при слой 0, леко нараства до около 0.2–0.3 в диапазона от слой 1 до слой 10, след което постепенно се увеличава до около 0.5 при слой 17. От слой 18 нататък линията показва рязко нарастване, достигайки връх от приблизително 4.5 при слой 22, след което леко спада до около 2.5 при слой 23. Втората линия, в оранжев цвят с точков (пунктиран) стил, представлява „hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Тя остава много близо до нулата през целия диапазон на оста X, от слой 0 до слой 23, с минимални колебания, които визуално почти не се различават от нулевата стойност. Третата линия, в зелен цвят с плътен стил, представлява „hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Тя също остава много близо до нулата през целия диапазон, като при последните слоеве (около 20–23) показва леко увеличение до приблизително 0.1, но остава значително по-ниска от синята линия. Легендата е разположена в горната лява част на графиката, а заглавието „Hidden State Mean" е поставено в горната централна част.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across network layers for three different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style, represents "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; it starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively low around 0.2–0.3 through approximately layer 10, then begins to increase gradually, reaching about 0.5 around layer 17, before rising sharply to approximately 2.6 at layer 21, then dipping slightly to around 2.5 at layer 22, and finally spiking to approximately 4.5 at layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; it remains very close to 0 across all layers, staying nearly flat from layer 0 through layer 23 with only minimal variation, reaching at most approximately 0.1 near the final layers. The third line, shown in green with a solid line style, represents "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; it similarly stays very close to 0 throughout all layers, largely overlapping with the orange line, with values barely distinguishable from zero across the entire range and reaching approximately 0.1 by layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across layers of a model, comparing values before gating, after gating, and for a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5.

The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style, represents the "hidden state mean before gate" with a reported average of 0.71. It starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively low and fluctuates between approximately 0.1 and 0.3 through layers 0 to 10, then begins to increase more steeply around layer 12, reaching approximately 0.5 near layer 17. It then rises sharply from around layer 18 onward, peaking at approximately 4.5 near layer 22 before declining slightly to around 2.5 at layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents the "hidden state mean after gate" with a reported average of 0.05. This line remains very close to 0.0 across all layers, with only a very slight increase visible toward the final layers, reaching approximately 0.1 by layer 23. The third line, shown in green with a solid line style, represents the "hidden state mean of baseline" with a reported average of 0.04. This line similarly stays very close to 0.0 throughout all layers, with a slight upward trend toward the later layers, reaching approximately 0.1 by layer 23. The orange and green lines are nearly overlapping and visually difficult to distinguish from each other across most of the layer range.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm mit dem Titel „Hidden State Mean" stellt den absoluten Mittelwert des Hidden States über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells dar und vergleicht drei verschiedene Bedingungen. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0,5 (0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5). Die erste Linie, dargestellt als blaue gestrichelte Linie, repräsentiert den „hidden state mean before gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,71. Sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei einem Wert nahe 0,1, schwankt leicht zwischen etwa 0,1 und 0,3 bis Layer 10, steigt dann allmählich an und erreicht bei Layer 17 etwa 0,5, bevor sie ab Layer 19 steil ansteigt und bei Layer 21 einen Wert von etwa 2,6 erreicht, gefolgt von einem kurzen Rückgang auf etwa 2,5 bei Layer 22 und einem erneuten starken Anstieg auf etwa 4,5 bei Layer 23. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt als orange gepunktete Linie, repräsentiert den „hidden state mean after gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,05. Sie verläuft nahezu konstant nahe 0 über alle Schichten hinweg, mit nur minimalen Schwankungen, und erreicht am Ende bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 0,1. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt als grüne durchgezogene Linie, repräsentiert den „hidden state mean of baseline" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,04. Sie verläuft ebenfalls nahezu konstant nahe 0 über den gesamten Bereich der Schichten und endet bei Layer 23 bei einem Wert von etwa 0,1, wobei sie weitgehend mit der orangen Linie überlappt.
